## Setup

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

## Data

```{python}
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "x": [1, 2, 3, 4],
    "y": [10, 15, 25, 30]
})
df
```

## Plot

```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Simple line plot"
plt.plot(df["x"], df["y"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("X")
plt.ylabel("Y")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
